column1: # The files fly/Dockerfile downloads at build time, pinned by sha256.
#   name    sha256    upstream URL(s), nearest first
# fly/fetch.sh fetches a file by name from each URL in turn and keeps the first whose
# bytes match the sha256; the checksum decides what is installed, never the host.
# The same shape as salishsea's fly/downloads.tsv (its decision 084); beeatlas has no
# mirror bucket of its own yet, so every row's sources are upstream.
# To move a pin: change the sha256 and the URL here, and let the image workflow's
# build prove it. uv publishes the checksum beside each release asset
# (uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256); DuckDB's is the one Stelis's CI pins
# and tests against (its .github/workflows/tests.yml). Caddy publishes SHA-512 sums
# (caddy_<v>_checksums.txt); the sha256 here was taken from the download that matched
